items.name: Bee
items.ask: Who is buzzing in the garden? Can you guess?
items.hint: It goes buzz buzz and makes yummy honey!

items.name: Ladybug
items.hint: It is tiny and red with little black spots!

items.name: Ant
items.hint: It is very small and very, very strong!

items.name: Butterfly
items.ask: Last one! Who is this shadow?
items.hint: It has big, pretty wings and flies from flower to flower!

outro_screen:
You got them all!
How many did
YOU guess?
outro: Wow! You got them all! How many did you guess?

seo.title: Guess the Bug Shadow! 🐝🐞 Insects for Kids | Shadow Game for Kids | Unique Kiddo
seo.description:
Can your little one guess the bug from its shadow? 🤔 Look, listen to the clue, and shout the answer with Kiddo!

A quick insects guessing game for kids. Children learn 4 insect names:
🐝 Bee
🐞 Ladybug
🐜 Ant
🦋 Butterfly

Each round has think time so kids can guess, and a "say it with me" pause to practise new English words. Great for toddlers, preschool and kindergarten (ages 2–6).

⭐ Subscribe to Unique Kiddo for more fun learning games: animals, vehicles, letters, numbers and more!

Voice: Kokoro TTS (Apache 2.0) · Emoji art: Noto Emoji (Apache 2.0)
